title: limnas pilosa
intro: Limnas pilosa, commonly known as soft leaved cat's foot or cat's foot, is a flowering plant species in the family Gentianaceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Limnas pilosa include wound healing, antifungal, and antibacterial activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. Further research is needed to fully understand the potential health benefits and mechanisms of action of Limnas pilosa.
